assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: richly detailed hand-painted illustrated world map for CampusQuest AI, a Vietnamese boarding cadet school exploration game. Create a beautiful premium game campus map viewed DIRECTLY STRAIGHT DOWN, orthographic top-down, flat geography, not an isometric diorama. Landscape 6:5 composition, entire rectangular campus visible with a small surrounding forest margin. Warm cream plaster buildings, terracotta tiled roofs, lush central Vietnamese highland vegetation, elegant sand-colored footpaths, flowering trees, soft warm sunlight, fine painterly game-environment detail, welcoming and scholarly. Match this exact north-up layout using percentage positions in image: central main headquarters at (50%,36%), small library (40%,41%) and small canteen (60%,44%), spacious flag courtyard at (50%,53%); two dormitory buildings in the northwest at (13%,32%) and (13%,45%); dining hall at (13%,66%); large multipurpose hall at (14%,86%); two classroom blocks across north-center at (39%,10%) and (61%,10%); computer laboratory northeast at (87%,8%), language classroom east-northeast at (87%,28%); clearly marked football pitch with white lines, green grass, two goals and small bleachers in the east from (77%,37%) to (90%,70%); learning garden and reading pavilion south-center near (50%,88%). Broad looping paths on x=29%,71% and horizontal y=20%,80%, connected by smaller paths, central axial path to southern school gate. Add vivid but tasteful landscaping, benches, little lamps, planted gardens, tiled courtyards, visible distinct roof designs. True top-down view, maintain requested locations and coherent pathways so a developer can overlay clickable destination pins. Dense enough to feel like a large explorable school, crisp and polished with readable silhouettes at small sizes. No words, letters, labels, numbers, UI, borders, watermark, characters, inset panels or legend. This is an original game map illustration, not a claim to reproduce a surveyed real school site.

Every panel is an exquisite detailed cozy isometric cutaway architectural illustration, consistent premium hand-painted 3D adventure game art, warm cream plaster, wood and forest green, terracotta accents, luminous morning light, lush plants, natural material detail. TOP LEFT: classroom with orderly wooden desks, green chalkboard, books, windows onto flowering trees. TOP MIDDLE: computer laboratory with neat rows of modern desktop computers, teal screens, keyboards, comfortable chairs and sunlit cream walls. BOTTOM LEFT: comfortable student dormitory with tidy bunk beds, olive blankets, wooden lockers, books, indoor plants, no people. BOTTOM MIDDLE: airy school dining hall with long wooden dining tables, trays of Vietnamese school meals, clean serving counter, tiled floor and open windows. All six images share same elevated isometric view angle, consistent rich refined forest green and warm gold color palette and high level of polished detail. Architecture and room contents only, no people, weapons or insignias. Each scene occupies its own equal cell with no overlap. Landscape overall canvas 3:2. This is a six scene environment atlas, not a website layout or collage of mismatched images.
